<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd" >
<mapper namespace="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.mapper.ScenesMgrDBMapper">
    <resultMap id="SceneInfo" type="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.model.Scene">
        <result property="sceneId" column="SCENE_ID"/>
        <result property="sceneName" column="SCENE_NAME"/>
        <result property="relateRegionId" column="RELATE_REGION_ID"/>
        <result property="description" column="SCENE_DESC"/>
        <result property="capacity" column="CAPACITY"/>
        <result property="nrUserPenetrationRate" column="USER_PENETRATION_RATE"/>
        <result property="sceneType" column="SCENE_TYPE"/>
        <result property="sceneCode" column="SCENE_CODE"/>
        <result property="cityCode" column="CITY_CODE"/>
        <result property="predictSwitch" column="PREDICT_SWITCH"/>
        <result property="dutyRatio" column="DUTY_RATIO"/>
        <result property="createType" column="CREATE_TYPE"/>
        <collection property="backgroundUserGroup" ofType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.model.BackgroundUserGroup" javaType="list">
            <result property="groupName" column="GROUP_NAME"/>
            <result property="nr5qi" column="NR5QI"/>
            <result property="qci" column="QCI"/>
            <result property="ulGmRate" column="UL_MGBR"/>
            <result property="dlGmRate" column="DL_MGBR"/>
            <collection property="ueGroups" ofType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.model.UEGroupUserSLAParam" javaType="list">
                <result property="fiveQI" column="LABEL_FIVE_QI" />
                <result property="rfsp" column="LABEL_RFSP" />
                <result property="qci" column="LABEL_QCI" />
                <result property="serviceType" column="LABEL_SERVICE_TYPE" />
            </collection>
        </collection>
        <collection property="bitPackageInfos" ofType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.model.BitPackageInfo" javaType="list">
            <result property="packageId" column="PACKAGE_ID"/>
            <result property="packageName" column="PACKAGE_NAME"/>
            <result property="ulRbWeight" column="UL_RB_WEIGHT"/>
            <result property="dlRbWeight" column="DL_RB_WEIGHT"/>
        </collection>
    </resultMap>

    <resultMap id="VenueInfo" type="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.model.VenueInfo">
        <result property="venueId" column="VENUE_ID"/>
        <result property="venueName" column="VENUE_NAME"/>
        <result property="indoorId" column="INDOOR_ID"/>
        <result property="description" column="DESCRIPTION"/>
        <result property="capacity" column="CAPACITY"/>
        <result property="userPenetrationRate" column="USER_PENETRATION_RATE"/>
    </resultMap>

    <select id="getScenes" resultMap="SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE.SCENE_ID,
            SCENE.SCENE_NAME,
            SCENE.SCENE_DESC,
            SCENE.USER_PENETRATION_RATE,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE,
            SCENE.PREDICT_SWITCH,
            VENUE.CAPACITY,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        LEFT JOIN T_MBB_VENUE_INFO VENUE ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = VENUE.VENUE_ID
        ORDER BY SCENE.SCENE_ID DESC
    </select>

    <select id="getVenuesByIds" resultMap="VenueInfo">
        SELECT
            VENUE.VENUE_ID,
            VENUE.VENUE_NAME,
            VENUE.INDOOR_ID,
            VENUE.DESCRIPTION,
            VENUE.CAPACITY,
            VENUE.USER_PENETRATION_RATE
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        JOIN T_MBB_VENUE_INFO VENUE
        ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = VENUE.VENUE_ID
        WHERE VENUE.VENUE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="venueIds" item="venueId" open="(" close=")" separator=",">
            #{venueId}
        </foreach>
    </select>

    <select id="getSceneRegionInfos" resultType="com.huawei.oss.wireless.experienceassuranceservice.venuealloc.impl.bean.SceneRegionInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE_ID as sceneId,
            SCENE_NAME as sceneName,
            SCENE_TYPE as sceneType,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as originRegionId,
            4 as originCategoryId,
            RELATE_REGION_ID as currentRegionId,
            4 as currentCategoryId
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE (SCENE_TYPE=1 OR SCENE_TYPE=2) AND RELATE_REGION_ID != -99999
    </select>

    <select id="getAllReferenceScenes" resultMap="SceneInfo">
        SELECT distinct
            SCENE.SCENE_ID,
            SCENE.SCENE_NAME,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_TASK TASK
        ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = TASK.SCENE_ID
        WHERE SCENE.SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator=", " close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>
    </select>

    <select id="getScene" resultMap="SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE.SCENE_ID,
            SCENE.SCENE_NAME,
            SCENE.RELATE_REGION_ID,
            SCENE.SCENE_DESC,
            VENUE.CAPACITY,
            SCENE.USER_PENETRATION_RATE,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID,
            PACKAGE.UL_RB_WEIGHT,
            PACKAGE.DL_RB_WEIGHT,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_NAME,
            USER_GROUP.GROUP_NAME,
            USER_GROUP.NR5QI,
            USER_GROUP.QCI,
            USER_GROUP.UL_MGBR,
            USER_GROUP.DL_MGBR,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE,
            SCENE.PREDICT_SWITCH,
            SCENE.DUTY_RATIO,
            LABEL.FIVE_QI as LABEL_FIVE_QI,
            LABEL.RFSP as LABEL_RFSP,
            LABEL.QCI as LABEL_QCI,
            LABEL.SERVICE_TYPE as LABEL_SERVICE_TYPE
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        LEFT JOIN T_MBB_VENUE_INFO VENUE ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = VENUE.VENUE_ID
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                PKG.PACKAGE_ID,
                PKG.UL_RB_WEIGHT,
                PKG.DL_RB_WEIGHT,
                PKG.SCENE_ID,
                EVA.PACKAGE_NAME
            FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE PKG INNER JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE EVA ON EVA.PACKAGE_ID = PKG.PACKAGE_ID
        ) PACKAGE ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = PACKAGE.SCENE_ID
        LEFT JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_BKG_USER USER_GROUP ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = USER_GROUP.SCENE_ID
        LEFT JOIN T_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_USER_PACKAGE_LABEL LABEL ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = LABEL.SCENE_ID AND USER_GROUP.GROUP_ID = LABEL.GROUP_ID
        WHERE SCENE.SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </select>

    <select id="getSceneByAddress" resultMap="SceneInfo">
        SELECT
            SCENE.SCENE_ID,
            SCENE.SCENE_NAME,
            SCENE.RELATE_REGION_ID,
            SCENE.SCENE_DESC,
            VENUE.CAPACITY,
            SCENE.USER_PENETRATION_RATE,
            SCENE.SCENE_TYPE,
            SCENE.SCENE_CODE,
            PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID,
            PACKAGE.UL_RB_WEIGHT,
            PACKAGE.DL_RB_WEIGHT,
            EVA.PACKAGE_CODE AS PACKAGE_NAME,
            USER_GROUP.GROUP_NAME,
            USER_GROUP.NR5QI,
            USER_GROUP.QCI,
            USER_GROUP.UL_MGBR,
            USER_GROUP.DL_MGBR,
            SCENE.CITY_CODE,
            SCENE.PREDICT_SWITCH,
            SCENE.CREATE_TYPE,
            SCENE.DUTY_RATIO,
            LABEL.FIVE_QI AS LABEL_FIVE_QI,
            LABEL.RFSP AS LABEL_RFSP,
            LABEL.QCI AS LABEL_QCI,
            LABEL.SERVICE_TYPE AS LABEL_SERVICE_TYPE
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        LEFT JOIN T_MBB_VENUE_INFO VENUE ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = VENUE.VENUE_ID
        LEFT JOIN T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE PACKAGE ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = PACKAGE.SCENE_ID
        LEFT JOIN T_MBB_ALLOC_EVA_PACKAGE EVA ON EVA.PACKAGE_ID = PACKAGE.PACKAGE_ID
        LEFT JOIN T_BIT_MENTOR_BKG_USER USER_GROUP ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = USER_GROUP.SCENE_ID
        LEFT JOIN T_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_USER_PACKAGE_LABEL LABEL ON SCENE.SCENE_ID = LABEL.SCENE_ID AND USER_GROUP.GROUP_ID = LABEL.GROUP_ID
        WHERE SCENE.SCENE_CODE = #{sceneCode} AND SCENE.SCENE_TYPE = #{sceneType} AND SCENE.CITY_CODE = #{cityCode}
    </select>

    <delete id="deleteSceneByIds">
        BEGIN
        DELETE FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_BKG_USER BKG_USER
        WHERE BKG_USER.SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach item="sceneId" collection="sceneIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        DELETE FROM T_MBB_VENUE_INFO VENUE
        WHERE VENUE.VENUE_ID IN
        <foreach item="sceneId" collection="sceneIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        DELETE FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE SCENE
        WHERE SCENE.SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach item="sceneId" collection="sceneIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>;
        END;
    </delete>

    <delete id="deletePackageBySceneIds">
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_PACKAGE
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>
    </delete>

    <delete id="deleteSceneBySceneIds">
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL
        WHERE SCENE_ID IN
        <foreach collection="sceneIds" item="sceneId" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{sceneId}
        </foreach>
    </delete>

    <delete id="deleteSceneCells">
        DELETE FROM T_RAN_ASSUR_SPIRIT_SCENE_CELL
        WHERE SCENE_ID = #{sceneId}
    </delete>

    <select id="getSceneNameCount" resultType="int" parameterType="String">
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE SCENE_NAME = #{sceneName}
    </select>

    <select id="getSceneCount" resultType="int">
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM T_BIT_MENTOR_SCENE
        WHERE SCENE_CODE = #{sceneCode} AND SCENE_TYPE = #{sceneType} AND CITY_CODE = #{cityCode}
    </select>

    <select id="getNewSceneId" resultType="integer">
        SELECT T_SMARTBOARD_TASK_BASIC_SEQ.NEXTVAL
        FROM SYS_DUMMY
